H01.description: cell_range indexes cell_offsets by the raw cell index among all cells, but offsets exist only for valid Python code cells, so notebooks with Markdown or cell-magic cells get the wrong range (or a range for a non-code cell).

H02.description: Doc comment clarifying the index semantics of cell_content_range.

H03.description: Test-module import update for the new test.

H04.description: Adds a regression test for cell_range lookup by raw cell index.

H05.description: Adds a cell_range helper that maps a cell URI to its raw index and uses Notebook::cell_range; no callers are visible, so intent is somewhat unclear, but it builds on the D1 fix.

H06.description: Adds an e2e test for cells after a cell-magic cell.
